title: Staff Success Playbook — Employee Lifecycle & Internal Tools
author: Aisha Patel
body:
Overview

Purpose: This playbook describes the end-to-end employee lifecycle at Redwood — from hiring and first-day tasks to role progression, benefits highlights, and the internal tools/services new hires need to be productive. It is intended for new employees, hiring managers, and people-ops partners as a single, pragmatic reference that ties process to ownership and SLAs.

Scope: working at Redwood, role & career touchpoints, benefits summary, hiring & onboarding timeline, and internal tools provisioning and troubleshooting guidance.

Quick links (one-line)
- New hire checklist: /confluence/company-handbook/04_hiring-and-onboarding/new-hire-checklist-2025
- Role level definitions: /confluence/company-handbook/02_roles-and-career/level-definitions-2024
- Benefits overview: /confluence/company-handbook/03_benefits-and-perks/benefits-summary-2025
- IT & access request: https://it.redwood.company/helpdesk

1) New hire timeline (owner: people-ops with IT & manager partners)
1. Pre-boarding (T-minus 7 days)
   - Offer acceptance: people-ops sends welcome packet, equity & payroll forms (owner: people-ops).
   - Equipment survey: new hire completes hardware preference form. SLA: IT acknowledges within 24 hours.
   - Access planning: hiring manager submits role-specific access matrix to IT and infra onboarding (owner: manager).

2. Day 0 / Day 1 (owner: hiring manager + buddy)
   - Welcome & orientation: people-ops runs company orientation (1.5 hours).
   - Workstation & accounts: IT provisions laptop, Okta, Google Workspace, Slack, Redwood GitHub org, and Jira. Typical delivery: same day for cloud accounts; hardware delivery varies by location (3–7 business days).
   - Team onboarding: manager hosts team kickoff with key stakeholders, explains immediate priorities, and assigns a buddy.

3. Week 1 (owner: manager + buddy)
   - Role ramp plan: manager shares 30/60/90 plan and first-priority tickets.
   - Access reviews: confirm access to private repos, dedicated infra/test clusters, and Redwood Console demo workspace.
   - Training: complete mandatory security & data handling courses (see section 5).

4. First 30/90 days (owner: manager + people-ops)
   - Weekly 1:1s for first 8 weeks.
   - 30-day sync: manager provides feedback on ramp and blockers.
   - 90-day review: informal calibration meeting (owner: people-ops coordinates) to confirm success metrics and next steps.

2) Role ladders & career progression (owner: people-ops + org leads)
- Philosophy: growth at Redwood emphasizes increasing scope, impact, and cross-functional leadership. Ladders describe expectations for competency, execution, mentorship, and influence.
- Ladder families: Engineering (IC: E1–E6; Manager: EM1–EM4), Product, Design, SRE, Research, Sales & GTM.
- Promotion cadence: typical eligibility window is 12–18 months at level with demonstrated impact; exceptions for quick promoters are evaluated via calibration committee.

Quick reference table (text format):
- Level / Typical title / Expectations (summary)
- E2 / Software Engineer II / Delivers features with guidance, owns small services or components.
- E4 / Senior Software Engineer / Owns cross-service designs, mentors peers, leads mid-size projects.
- EM2 / Engineering Manager / Manages multiple ICs, owns roadmap execution for a product area.

Promotion process (numbered):
1. Candidate self-nominates or manager nominates via promotion packet template.
2. Packet includes: impact examples, metrics, feedback, and proposed level.
3. Promotion committee reviews packet, conducts calibration. Typical decision window: 3 weeks.
4. If approved, people-ops implements comp adjustments and announcement.

3) Benefits & perks — practical summary (owner: finance-legal + people-ops)
- Health: comprehensive medical/dental/vision with multiple plan options (US & UK equivalents).
- Time off: flexible PTO with manager-approved patterns, 12 paid company holidays, plus parental leave policy (primary caregivers: 16 weeks; secondary: 8 weeks, subject to local law).
- Retirement: 401(k) with company match (US) and pension equivalents where applicable.
- Learning stipend: $2,000/year professional development budget + internal training days.
- Wellness: monthly stipend for mental health / fitness; EAP program available.
- Perks: commuter/remote allowance (region dependent), hardware refresh every 3 years, home office stipend at hire.

Note: full legal plan documents and eligibility rules live on the benefits portal (link in Quick links).

4) Internal tools and access matrix (owner: IT + eng-platform)
- Overview: the table below lists commonly used services, provisioning owner, typical SLA, and required roles/groups. Use the IT helpdesk for escalations.

Tool | Owner | Typical SLA | Access groups / Notes
---|---:|---:|---
Okta (SSO) | IT | 24h | All employees; follow MFA enrollment steps in IT KB.
Google Workspace | IT | 24h | Auto-provision via Okta; drive folder template for teams.
Slack | IT | same-day | Team channels created by manager; #all-hands and department channels auto-joined.
GitHub (org) | Eng-platform | 48h | Repo-level perms requested via PR to eng-ops-access; secret scans enabled.
Jira | Eng-platform | 48h | Project roles assigned by PM; use onboarding template.
Redwood Console (prod/demo) | Eng-platform | 72h | Demo access on request; prod access requires manager + security approval.
Internal VPN / VPC access | Infra | 3–5 days | Requires signed AUP and justification; private deployments access is scoped per customer.
HRIS & payroll | People-ops | 24h | Employee self-service; changes must be routed through people-ops.

Provisioning checklist for managers (short):
- Submit access matrix at offer stage.
- Confirm buddy assignment and 1:1 schedule.
- Create first PRD/ticket for new hire to ensure meaningful onboarding work.

5) Mandatory trainings & security baseline (owner: security-and-compliance)
- Complete within first 14 days: Security Awareness, Data Handling, Privacy Basics, and Phishing Simulation.
- Role-specific trainings: SRE/infra: Secrets management, SOC runbook; Engineering: secure coding checklist.
- Certification recordings: docs in /confluence/security-and-compliance/training.

6) First 90-day sample plan (manager + IC template)
- 0–30 days: learn codebase, shadow support rotations, complete small bugfix (ownership).
- 30–60 days: lead feature subtask end-to-end, present design to team, start contributing to roadmap discussions.
- 60–90 days: deliver a measurable project, present a 90-day retrospective and growth plan at 1:1.

7) Hiring manager playbook (concise checklist)
- Pre-offer: write a clear role brief, calibrate interview loop with hiring-bar rubric, plan diversity sourcing.
- Offer stage: complete role-specific access matrix and onboarding tasks in the offer packet.
- First week: run team kickoff, set 30/60/90 goals, and verify tool access.
- Monthly: career conversations, feedback collection, performance notes.

8) Escalations & support contacts
- IT & access issues: helpdesk ticket (https://it.redwood.company/helpdesk). Escalation path: IT on-call -> Eng-platform -> People-ops.
- Payroll/comp errors: people-ops compensation specialist (people-ops@redwood.company).
- Security incidents: security@redwood.company (24/7 pager for confirmed incidents).

9) FAQs (short)
- Q: When will my laptop arrive? A: Region-dependent; typical window is 3–7 business days after acceptance. For urgent needs, request temporary cloud workstation via IT.
- Q: How do I request additional access to a private customer environment? A: Manager must submit justification to security-and-compliance and infra; approval usually takes 3–5 business days.

10) Appendix: templates & links
- 30/60/90 plan template: /confluence/company-handbook/templates/30-60-90-template
- Promotion packet template: /confluence/company-handbook/templates/promotion-packet
- Manager onboarding checklist: /confluence/company-handbook/templates/manager-first-week

Owner & maintenance
- Document owner: people-ops (Aisha Patel). Review cadence: annual or after major policy change (finance/legal triggers).

Revision history
- 2024-11-15: Initial draft.
